```{r}
#| label: define-run-gradient-function
#| output: false
library(matrixTests)
library(data.table)
library(dtplyr)

# ---- called once per gene, reusing perm_mat ----
run_gradient <- function(raw_df, brain_map, map_col, perm_mat, method = "pearson") {
  corr_df <- raw_df %>%
    select(participant, dx, 
           any_of(glue("{brain_map$label}Transformed.q.zscore"))) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    pivot_longer(contains("zscore"), names_to = "label", 
                 values_to = "zscore") %>%
    mutate(label = str_remove(label, "Transformed.q.zscore")) %>%
    left_join(brain_map, by = "label") %>%
    rename(map = {{ map_col }}) %>%
    group_by(participant, dx) %>%
    summarize(corr = cor(zscore, map, method = method, use = "complete.obs"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(z = FisherZ(corr)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(z)) %>%
    as.data.table()

  # catches silent misalignment if this gene dropped different participants
  stopifnot(nrow(corr_df) == nrow(perm_mat))

  z  <- corr_df$z
  g1 <- corr_df$dx == "22q11DS"
  n1 <- sum(g1)
  n2 <- length(z) - n1

  # calculate observed t-statistic
  obs      <- col_t_welch(matrix(z[g1], ncol = 1), matrix(z[!g1], ncol = 1))
  t_actual <- obs$statistic
  # calculate median correlation with brain map
  corr_case <- median(corr_df$corr[g1])
  corr_cont <- median(corr_df$corr[!g1])
  
  # Calculate t-statistic for every permutation 
  Z_full <- matrix(z, nrow = length(z), ncol = ncol(perm_mat))
  x_mat  <- matrix(Z_full[perm_mat],  nrow = n1)
  y_mat  <- matrix(Z_full[!perm_mat], nrow = n2)
  t_perm   <- col_t_welch(x_mat, y_mat)$statistic
  
  # Find number of instances where permutation exceeds actual t
  p <- (1 + sum(abs(t_perm) >= abs(t_actual))) / (length(t_perm) + 1)

  list(map = map_col,
       corr_case = corr_case,
       corr_cont = corr_cont,
       t = t_actual, p = p,
       actual_corrs = corr_df)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: precompute-permutation-matrices

# Precalculate permutations
set.seed(2514)
n_perm <- 10000
# CHOP - All Samples
df_chop_full <- ind_df %>% filter(Source == "CHOP")
perm_mat_chop_full <- replicate(n_perm, sample(df_chop_full$dx == "22q11DS"))
# CHOP - CT subset
df_chop_mpr <- ind_df %>% filter(Source == "CHOP", !is.na(meanCTTransformed.q.zscore))
perm_mat_chop_mpr <- replicate(n_perm, sample(df_chop_mpr$dx == "22q11DS"))
# ENIGMA
df_enigma <- ind_df %>% filter(Source == "ENIGMA")
perm_mat_enigma <- replicate(n_perm, sample(df_enigma$dx == "22q11DS"))
```

## Correlate Deviation Maps with AHBA PC1

```{r}
#| label: pc1-correlation-permutation-test
maps <- c("abagen")
cats = c("GM","SA","CT")
cohorts <- c("CHOP","ENIGMA")

res <- expand_grid(measure = cats, map = maps, Source = cohorts)
res$t <- NA
res$corr_case <- NA
res$corr_cont <- NA
res$p    <- NA
actual_corrs <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(res)) {
  # Define permutation matrix and data matrix
  if (res$Source[i] == "CHOP") {
    if (res$measure[i] != "CT") {
      df_test <- df_chop_full
      perm_mat <- perm_mat_chop_full
    } else {
      df_test <- df_chop_mpr
      perm_mat <- perm_mat_chop_mpr
    }
  } else {
    df_test <- df_enigma
    perm_mat <- perm_mat_enigma
  }
  # Define brain map
  brain_map <- df %>% 
                select(label, all_of(res$map[i])) %>% 
                filter(grepl(glue("{res$measure[i]}\\."), label))
  
  perm_res <- run_gradient(df_test, brain_map, res$map[i], perm_mat, method = "pearson")
  res[i, "t"] <- perm_res$t
  res[i, "corr_case"] <- perm_res$corr_case
  res[i, "corr_cont"] <- perm_res$corr_cont
  res[i, "p"] <- perm_res$p
  actual_corrs[[i]]  <- perm_res$actual_corrs %>% mutate(measure = res$measure[i],
                                                         Source = res$Source[i],
                                                         map = res$map[i])
}

print(res %>% arrange(Source, map, measure))
actual_corrs <- bind_rows(actual_corrs)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-correlation-bar-plots
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of individual-level correlations between regional deviation scores and the AHBA gene expression PC1 map (CHOP cohort), by diagnostic group and brain measure."
corr_plots_bar <- function(corrs, brain_map = NULL) {
  ggplot(corrs %>%
                 mutate(dx = factor(dx, levels = c("22q11DS","CN"), 
                                    labels = c("22q11DS","Control")),
                        measure = factor(measure, levels = c("GM","SA","CT"), 
                                    labels = c("Gray Matter Volume","Surface Area",
                                               "Cortical Thickness"))), 
               aes(x = dx, y = corr)) + 
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          geom_boxplot() + 
          theme_pubclean() +
          xlab("") +
          ylab("Pearson's r") +
          theme(
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
              strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, color = "black"),
              strip.text.y      = element_text(angle = 270)
            ) + aes(fill = dx) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("22q11DS" = "firebrick", 
                                       "Control" = "grey60"), 
                            guide = "none")
  
}

bar_plots <- list()
for (source in c("CHOP","ENIGMA")) {
  bar_plots[[source]] <- list()
  for (cat in cats) {
    corr_data <- actual_corrs %>% 
                    filter(Source == "CHOP", map == "abagen", measure == cat)
    
    bar_plots[[source]][[cat]] <- corr_plots_bar(corr_data)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: per-gene-permutation-test-parallel
#| output: false
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
n_cores <- 36
# Register cluster

cats = c("GM","SA", "CT")
cohorts <- c("CHOP", "ENIGMA")
actual_corrs <- list()
j <- 1
maps <- res_exp_final$gene
for (cohort in c("CHOP", "ENIGMA")) {
  for (cat in cats) {
    # Define permutation matrix and data matrix
    if (cohort == "CHOP") {
      suf <- ""
      if (cat != "CT") {
        df_test <- df_chop_full
        perm_mat <- perm_mat_chop_full
      } else {
        df_test <- df_chop_mpr
        perm_mat <- perm_mat_chop_mpr
      }
    } else {
      suf <- "_ENIGMA"
      df_test <- df_enigma
      perm_mat <- perm_mat_enigma
    }
    cluster <- makeCluster(n_cores)
    registerDoParallel(cluster)
    res <- expand_grid(measure = cat, map = maps, Source = cohort)
    
    results <- list()
    start.time <- Sys.time()
    
    results <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(res), 
                       .packages = c("tidyverse","glue", "DescTools",
                                     "dtplyr","data.table","matrixTests")) %dorng% {
        # Define brain map
        brain_map <- res_exp %>%
                        filter(measure == res$measure[i]) %>%
                        select(label, !!res$map[i])
        # Run permutation
        perm_results <- run_gradient(df_test, brain_map, res$map[i], 
                                 perm_mat, method = "pearson")
        # Append results
        results[[i]] <- list("summary" = perm_results[c("map","corr_case","corr_cont","t","p")],
                             "actual_corrs" = list(perm_results[["actual_corrs"]] %>%
                                                     mutate(gene = res$map[i],
                                                            measure = res$measure[i],
                                                            Source = res$Source[i])))
    }
    
    # Curate correlations and summary
    res <- as_tibble(list(v=results)) %>% unnest_wider(v)
    actual_corrs[[j]] <- bind_rows(res$actual_corrs)
    res <- bind_rows(res$summary)
    end.time <- Sys.time()
    time.taken <- round(end.time - start.time,2)
    time.taken
    stopCluster(cluster)
    
    write_csv(res,glue("../tables/gene_correlation_perms_ind_{cat}{suf}.csv"))
    j <- j + 1
  }

}
actual_corrs <- bind_rows(actual_corrs)
```

```{r}
#| label: define-gene-set-enrichment-function
#| output: false
# Genome-wide gene-set enrichment test: is the 22q11.2 deletion locus gene set
# more strongly correlated with the 22q11DS-specific brain deviation pattern
# than expected by chance? Null = medians of random equal-sized gene sets.
test_enrichment <- function(df, value_col = "eff_size", gene_col = "gene_22q",
                            n_perm = 10000, seed = 2514) {
  set.seed(seed)
  # Get 22q test set size
  n_22q    <- sum(df[[gene_col]])
  all_vals <- df[[value_col]]
  # Find NA values in enrichment variable
  n_na <- sum(is.na(all_vals))
  if (n_na > 0) {
    all_vals <- all_vals[!is.na(all_vals)]
    message(glue("Dropped {n_na} gene(s) with NA {value_col}"))
  }
  # Compare stats based on which enrichment variable we are using
  if (value_col == "rank") {
    # one-sided test that 22q genes are more aligned
    obs_stat <- median(df[[value_col]][df[[gene_col]]])
    null_stats <- replicate(n_perm, median(sample(all_vals, n_22q)))
  } else {
    # two-sided test that 22q genes are more extreme
    obs_stat <- median(abs(df[[value_col]][df[[gene_col]]]))
    null_stats <- replicate(n_perm, median(abs(sample(all_vals, n_22q))))
  }
  # Calculate permutation p-value
  p <- (1 + sum(null_stats >= obs_stat)) / (n_perm + 1)
  tibble(obs = obs_stat,
       null_mean = mean(null_stats),
       null_median = median(null_stats),
       null_sd = sd(null_stats),
       p = p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-enrichment-and-context-plots
#| output: false
context_plots <- list()
perm_df <- list()
enrich_list <- tibble()
for (source in c("CHOP","ENIGMA")) {
  context_plots[[source]] <- list()
  perm_df[[source]] <- list()
  if (source == "ENIGMA") {
    suf <- "_ENIGMA"
  } else {
    suf <- ""
  }
  for (measure in c("GMV","SA","CT")) {
    m <- substr(measure,1,2)
    filename <- glue("../tables/gene_correlation_perms_ind_{m}{suf}.csv")
    perm_df[[source]][[measure]] <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = F) %>%
            mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
                   gene = res_exp_final$gene,
                   gene_22q = res_exp_final$gene_22q,
                   measure = measure,
                   abs_corr = abs(corr_case),
                   eff_size = abs(t))
    perm_df[[source]][[measure]]$rank = 1 - data.table::frank(perm_df[[source]][[measure]],
                                      -abs_corr, p, 
                                      ties.method = "dense")/nrow(perm_df[[source]][[measure]])
    
    perm_df[[source]][[measure]] <- perm_df[[source]][[measure]] %>% arrange(-rank)
    
    enrich <- test_enrichment(perm_df[[source]][[measure]], 
                              "abs_corr")
    enrich_list <-  bind_rows(enrich_list, 
                           enrich %>% mutate(Source = source, measure = measure))
    
    perm_df[[source]][[measure]]$abs_corr <- abs(perm_df[[source]][[measure]]$corr_case)
    genes_22q   <- perm_df[[source]][[measure]] %>% filter(gene_22q)
    genes_no22q <- perm_df[[source]][[measure]] %>% filter(!gene_22q)
    
    
    context_plots[[source]][[measure]] <- ggplot(perm_df[[source]][[measure]], 
                                                 aes(abs_corr)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey75", color = "white") +
      geom_rug(data = genes_22q, aes(abs_corr), color = "firebrick", 
               linewidth = 1, sides = "b") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = median(genes_no22q$abs_corr), 
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = median(genes_22q$abs_corr), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
      annotate("text", x = median(genes_22q$abs_corr), y = Inf, 
               hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.6,
               size = annotation_pt(base_font-1), color = "firebrick", 
               label = glue('22q genes\np = {enrich %>% pull(p) %>% signif(2)}')) +
      theme_pubclean() +
      xlab("Pearson's |r|\n(individual genes)") +
      ylab("Gene Count")

  }
}
```

### Assemble Figures 3 and S9

```{r}
#| label: define-figure3-plot-helpers
#| output: false
# Formatting helpers used only to assemble the multi-panel Figure 3 / Figure S9
# layouts below. They live here rather than in utils.R because no other script
# uses them.
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)

# Slightly smaller axis text than figure_theme, for the dense per-gene panels
plot_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_text(size = base_font))

# Adds a Wilcoxon-test significance bracket between the two diagnostic groups
add_box_sig <- function(p, groups = c("22q11DS", "Control")) {
  p + geom_signif(comparisons = list(groups), test = "wilcox.test",
                  map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 2.4, tip_length = 0.01)
}

panel_title <- function(p, label, italic = FALSE) {
  p + ggtitle(label) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                     face = if (italic) "italic" else "plain"))
}

# Render a standalone row-spanning title
row_title <- function(text, italic = FALSE, bold = TRUE) {
  if (italic & bold) {
    ff <- "bold.italic"
  } else if (italic) {
    ff <- "italic"
  } else if (bold) {
    ff <- "bold"
  } else {
    ff <- "plain"
  }
  wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob(
    text,
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = ff,
                    fontfamily = "Helvetica")
  ))
}

colorbar_guide <- function(title) {
  guide_colorbar(title,
                 barwidth = unit(2, "cm"),
                 barheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                 title.theme = element_text(angle = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
                 title.position = "top",
                 title.hjust = 0.5)
}
```

```{r}
p_context_ct <- p_context_ct + ggtitle("CT Correlation")

# Combine plots
w4 <- c(1, 1, 1, 1.1)

row_pc1 <- (p_pc1_gm | p_pc1_sa | p_pc1_ct | p_pc1_brain) +

row_ctx <- (p_context_gm | p_context_sa | p_context_ct) +

row_gen <- (p_gene_gm | p_gene_sa | p_gene_ct | p_brain) +

  row_title("AHBA Gene Expression PC1 Correlation") /
```
